serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I’m going back to the supermarket to talk with that suspicious cashier.
What should be my gameplan today?
In the end, no one of the people I asked for help had any brilliant ideas.
Either way, I need to be careful. I don’t want her and her owner to get busted by the police or for them to leave the city.
If someone overhears her admitting to being a bot, it will be the end for her.
I think the best course of action would be waiting until her shift is over and talking to her in some deserted place. That way we wouldn’t be bothered by any onlookers.
According to my calculations she should be leaving her shop any minute now…
I see her!
Lucky for me, she went to some rundown alleyway.
